dct_description_sm: Historical dataset of Building footprints in Tacoma, Washington (State) as of 2024. Building footprints covering the City of Tacoma 2024 Lidar project area. This data is static and some parts of this data may no longer represent actual surface conditions. For reference use only. City of Tacoma 2024 Lidar The purpose of the lidar data was to produce a high accuracy 3D dataset that meets all necessary standards laid out by the 3D Elevation Program and the City of Tacoma Lidar contract. The lidar point cloud data were used to create classified lidar LAS files, intensity images, hydro-flattened DEMs, highest hit surface models, 3D building footprints , Canopy Cover Models, Solar Exposure models, Ray Traced RGBIR Images, and 3D breaklines of rivers and lakes within the study area. Product: 3D building footprints covering the City of Tacoma Lidar project area. Geographic Extent: This dataset and derived products encompass an area covering approximately 43,613 acres of Western Washington. Dataset Description: Lidar flight line swaths were processed to create 445 classified LAS 1.4 files delineated in 2250ft x 2250ft tiles. Each LAS file contains lidar point information, which has been calibrated, controlled, and classified. All permanent building structures exceeding 200 square feet were initially classified in the point cloud and then extracted using proprietary methods. Additional products include classified LAS files, intensity images, Hydroflattened DEMs, and highest hit surface models, 3D building footprints, Canopy Cover Models, Solar Exposure models, Ray Traced RGBIR Images. Ground Conditions: Ground condition was free of snow and acquisition occurred free of smoke, fog and cloud cover. Contractor: NV5 Ground Control Points were acquired and calibrated by NV5. Data acquisition was coordinated by NV5 and all lidar data calibration, and follow-on processing were completed by NV5. Elevation Units: U.S. Feet
